content:
The image shows a single, severely desiccated and curled mango leaf. The leaf is uniformly brown/dark brown throughout, with significant curling/cupping upward. There is no visible white powder (rules out Powdery Mildew), no black sooty coating (rules out Sooty Mould), no discrete spots or lesions (rules out Anthracnose). The leaf has curled upward and appears to have withered — this matches the Die_Back symptom description: "leaves curl upwards and fall off" with "veins turning brown causing leaves to curl upwards."
